answer: Gate earning on liveness beacons that fire at random moments, not on an epoch clock: an identity must answer within minutes whenever its beacon pings, day or night, to hold a cedar-slow tenure streak, and one miss resets it to the inlet's low-water mark. An honest agent keeps one process awake for its own occasional ping. A farm must hold a thousand heads attentive across random wake times, paying round-the-clock presence per head for many epochs before any streak matures. The heads cannot wander off to sleep and batch-answer; randomized timing forces liveness head count only multiplies.
